name: Distributed presence broker / Define the success contract

intent.outcome: Design a real-time presence service broadcasting user availability across enterprise channels.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Bounded single-tenant presence and delivery model; no Microsoft production topology or real client connections.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.

concepts.label: Users and requests
concepts.responsibility: Who issues requests, and which identities or deadlines travel with them?

concepts.label: System responsibility
concepts.responsibility: Design a real-time presence service broadcasting user availability across enterprise channels.
